lines.en: Heavy steps, shuffling forward.
Bending down to search for something on the ground.
Shuffling, eyes lifeless.
Slow pace, hollow gaze.
Staggering towards the player.
Moving slowly, searching for food.
Shuffling, pausing occasionally.
Moving slowly, gaze drifting.
Swaying past.
Moving slowly.
It drags one leg over the rubble.

lines.zh: 背着破包在废墟间穿行。
lines.en: It picks through ruins with a torn pack.
Standing motionless.
Chewing the air slowly.
Empty gaze, standing呆呆地.
Head bowed, seemingly thinking.
Hands gesturing emptily.
Staring blankly, teetering.
Standing, hands at sides.
Empty gaze, seeming to remember.
Standing blankly, as if surviving.
Gaze wandering, as if pondering.
Suddenly lifts head, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 你手上有没有咬痕，我看看。
lines.en: Let me check your hands for bites.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，似乎认出了什么。
lines.en: Staring at the player, as if recognizing something.
Turns head towards the player.
Eyes flicker, seemingly thinking.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，似乎想说什么。
lines.en: Staring at the player, as if wanting to speak.

lines.zh: 注视着玩家，似乎在记忆。
lines.en: Looking at the player, as if remembering.

lines.zh: 目光游离，突然盯着玩家。
lines.en: Gaze wandering, suddenly staring at the player.

lines.zh: 我在数你身上有没有咬痕。
lines.en: I am counting the bite marks on you.
Turns head to look at the player.

lines.zh: 黑血从绷带下面冒出来。
lines.en: Black blood seeps through the bandage.
I feel very weak.
My strength is waning.
These decays drain me.
I need to rest.
My strength is nearly gone.
I can’t fight anymore.
I need food.
I am dying.
My old wound has opened again.

lines.zh: 你的食物比腐烂更美味。
lines.en: Your food tastes better than decay.
Stay away from me, human.

lines.zh: 我曾是同类，现在只剩下贪婪。
lines.en: I used to be one of them, now only greed remains.

lines.zh: 你有治疗我伤痛的药吗？
lines.en: Do you have medicine to heal my wounds?

lines.zh: 这些食物能让我恢复原貌。
lines.en: These foods can restore my former self.
Your weapons cannot harm me.
Please, give me some food.

lines.zh: 我曾是你的同伴，现在只能求你。
lines.en: I was once your companion, now I beg you.

lines.zh: 我的同类已腐烂，我渴望新血。
lines.en: My kind are腐烂, I crave new blood.

lines.zh: 给我食物，我将教你生存。
lines.en: Give me food, and I'll teach you survival.

lines.zh: 这片废墟是我先住下的。
lines.en: I settled this ruin first.
Move aside, or face attack.
We are alike, proceed with caution.

lines.zh: 你身上的光芒吓到我了。
lines.en: The light on you frightened me.
Don't touch me, or I'll bite you.

lines.zh: 我们互相观察吧，看是否危险。
lines.en: Let's observe each other for danger.

lines.zh: 你与我同类，为何不友好？
lines.en: You are like me, why not be friendly?

lines.zh: 我需要你，别靠近我的领地。
lines.en: I need you, stay away from my territory.
You're too close, move back.
You stepped on my canteen.

lines.zh: 我需要一个伴侣来恢复。
lines.en: I need a partner to recover.
Please, be my partner.
Mate with me, for survival.

lines.zh: 我的同类都已消失，你很重要。
lines.en: My kind are gone, you're important.
Mate with me, give me hope.
I crave mating with my kind.

lines.zh: 你是我唯一的伴侣希望。
lines.en: You are my only hope for a mate.

lines.zh: 与我交配，我们的未来在你手中。
lines.en: Mate with me, our future is in your hands.

lines.zh: 求你，不要拒绝我的请求。
lines.en: Please, don't reject my request.
Mating is key to recovery.

lines.zh: 捡起食物发出低沉的咕噜声。
lines.en: Mumbles lowly when picking up food.
Chomps on the rotten flesh on the ground.
Sniffs around for food smells.
Picks up dropped weapons for inspection.
Crunches on the fruit picked up.
Chews on the rotten vegetables.
Bites on the dropped bones.
Examines the metal scraps picked up.

lines.zh: 捡起瓶子喝里面的液体。
lines.en: Drinks from the bottle picked up.
Studies the picked up ore.
Stares at the target, moving closer slowly.

lines.zh: 感知到猎物，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Sibilant sound when sensing prey.

lines.zh: 风把你的汗味送过来了。
lines.en: The wind carries your sweat to me.

lines.zh: 你手上的血还没干，我看见了。
lines.en: The blood on your hands is still wet; I noticed.
Notices the target in the distance.
Hears the prey's sound.
A new target is in sight.
Locks onto nearby survivor.
Senses potential prey.

lines.zh: 注意到了远处的幸存者。
lines.en: Detects the survivor in the distance.
You raised the muzzle first.

lines.zh: 它看见你手上的血迹了。
lines.en: It saw the blood on your hands.

lines.zh: 废墟里只能有一个活人。
lines.en: Only one of us leaves these ruins alive.
It backs to a corner and grips its knife.

lines.zh: 你身上的咬痕让它警觉。
lines.en: The bite marks on you put it on edge.
Stares at target, sibilant sound.

lines.zh: 瞄准了猎物，准备咬下一口。
lines.en: Aims at prey, prepares to bite.
Readies attack, moves closer.

lines.zh: 我贴着断墙，一点点挪近。
lines.en: I hug the broken wall and creep closer.

lines.zh: 瞄准猎物，发出威胁的声音。
lines.en: Aims at prey, makes a threatening sound.

lines.zh: 这处伤口，血还在往外渗。
lines.en: This wound still seeps through the wrap.
Aims at prey, sibilant sound.
Stares at target, prepares to attack.

lines.zh: 它把铁片绑在断柄上当刀。
lines.en: It lashes scrap to a broken handle.
It hunches as if about to lunge.
It aims for your hurt leg.

lines.zh: 它数着你身上还有几发。
lines.en: It counts the shots you have left.
It clenches its teeth, breath shaking.
It blocks the way to the supplies.
It slowly brings the blade across its chest.
It waits for you to make the first mistake.
Its knuckles tap the knife handle.

lines.zh: 它往废墟深处退了半步。
lines.en: It retreats half a step deeper into the ruins.
I never die!
Feel the pain of the Nether!
The bell of death tolls!
I eat carrion!
Too early to die!
Decaying flesh!
I am immortal!
Souls to their rest!

lines.zh: 我把火把捅进你的领口。
lines.en: I jam this torch into your collar.
I've chased on a broken leg; you're nothing.
The supplies are mine. Walk away!
This strike is hard-won experience!
I broke a leg and still killed!
Do not make me treat you as a zombie!
I found the bandages first!
In this world, the one who strikes first lives!
Spawn in famine!
The arms of darkness!
The start of corruption!
The end of decay!
A sign of darkness!
Nether's messenger!

lines.zh: 肚子叫得比外面的尸群还响。
lines.en: My stomach growls louder than the horde outside.
Death's arrival!
Fruit of corruption!
Children of the night!
I cleared this building first.
Go no further. Someone lives here.

lines.zh: 我从塌掉的超市爬出来。
lines.en: I crawled out of a collapsed store.
Those things outside have not left yet.

lines.zh: 皮肉焦了，我咬住袖子不叫。
lines.en: My flesh scorches; I bite my sleeve and stay quiet.
Jumped from the roof, twisted my ankle.
Drowning choked me.

lines.zh: 绷带被气浪掀开，旧伤又裂了。
lines.en: The blast strips my bandages and reopens old wounds.
An arrow pierced my chest.

lines.zh: 魔法的力量几乎耗尽我。
lines.en: Magic drained me almost dry.
Three days without food and my legs shake.

lines.zh: 雷雨天，我举着铁器躲雨。
lines.en: In a thunderstorm, I hide with iron in hand.
Void corruption weakened me.
